text: Aurelia Air will open a new hub at Castellane Airfield next month, company officials said Monday as crews began marking out the carrier’s first dedicated gates on the east apron. I watched workers string up the teal-and-gold signs while airport director Lena Voss said the airline plans to base six aircraft here by spring and add 48 weekly departures. “This is a real turning point for Castellane,” Voss told me outside the terminal. Aurelia Air spokeswoman Mirelle Dane said the hub will start with flights to Halden, Riva, and Port Elion on 14 October, with ticket sales opening Friday. Local taxi drivers nearby said they expect the extra traffic to fill the stand by dawn.
